summary_en: AirTrip acquired 876,700 shares (4.4% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) via ToSTNeT-3 on September 8, 2026, at 778 yen per share for a total of 682,072,600 yen. The acquisition limit was increased from 681,195,900 yen following a recent stock price rise.
title_en: Notice regarding Change in Disclosure Matters: Acquisition of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On September 7, 2026, AirTrip Corp. announced a block acquisition of its own shares via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading. The company acquired 876,700 shares on September 8, 2026, at the closing price of 778 yen per share, for a total outlay of 682,072,600 yen. This represented 4.4% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. The acquisition was part of a share buyback program authorized by the board on September 2, 2026.

The company raised its acquisition price limit from 681,195,900 yen to 682,072,600 yen in response to a recent rise in the stock price. The increase of 876,900 yen reflected market conditions at the time of execution. The buyback order was placed for the specific trading session of September 8, 2026, at 8:45 a.m. and was conditional on available sell orders matching the buy order. The company had obtained an agreement from Midas Project Co., Ltd., a significant shareholder, to participate in the block transaction.
